name: grid-holes
title: A. 2 mm grid, wider hole margin
note: Straight columns and rows; the routing plan already worked out still applies.

name: grid-bay
title: B. 2 mm grid, clear bay over USB-C
note: A clean notch instead of scattered gaps. Only 228 sites fit on this grid.

name: vogel-turned
title: C. Sunflower, LEDs turned with their angle
note: Golden angle. Opposing spirals appear by themselves, 21 and 34 of each wind near the rim, 8 and 13 near the centre. Pink and blue mark every third arm of each wind.

name: vogel-turned-bay
title: D. Sunflower, turned, clear bay over USB-C
note: Same lattice with a deliberate notch: it packs tighter to make up the 234.

name: vogel-holes
title: E. Sunflower, LEDs all square to the board
note: Simplest to assemble, but corners nearly touch, too tight to route.

name: nested
title: F. Nested golden spirals
note: True golden spirals with 5, 8, 13 then 21 arms in nested zones; an LED at each crossing of opposing arms.

name: arms-13
title: G. Overlaid opposing arms, 13 each way
note: LEDs strung along true golden arcs, clockwise and anticlockwise. The arcs show as lines, with diamond gaps between.

name: arms-21
title: H. Overlaid opposing arms, 21 each way
note: Finer weave of the same idea.
